Scenario: Reviewed plan expires or configuration/chapter set changes
Acceptance: Reject stale request, show difference; never silently substitute current plan.

Scenario: Crash/DB failure between physical action and reference commit
Acceptance: Durable journal, retain original where possible, verify receipts on restart and block ambiguous operation.

Scenario: Case-only rename, shared volume, occupied destination
Acceptance: Preserve all chapter mappings; no-clobber on qualified filesystem; original and destination unaffected on refusal.

Scenario: Candidate survivor missing, ambiguous, misparsed or different coverage
Acceptance: Keep files and references; no duplicate resolution based on names alone.

Scenario: File changes, hardlink alias or root alias after preview
Acceptance: Revalidate digest, object identity, root epoch and reference graph; refuse unsafe retirement.

Scenario: Unauthorized actor or stale bulk item; one item fails
Acceptance: No unauthorized effects; return durable per-item outcome, no false batch success.

Scenario: Multi-root move with occupied secondary root or concurrent read/write
Acceptance: Fence operations, preserve privacy, IDs, progress and sidecars; recover all roots.

Scenario: Metadata enrichment of hardlinked archive, concurrent source replacement
Acceptance: Copy-on-write, source bytes unchanged, stage independently verified; no mutation of seeding file.

Scenario: No-replace unsupported or crash after publication
Acceptance: Qualified primitive only; keep both names if uncertain, reconcile receipt without blind retries or overwrites.

Scenario: Slow active write passes scan cap or root disappears
Acceptance: Treat readiness as unknown; read-only scan findings cannot authorize deletion.

Scenario: No permission, install-only, uninstall-only, update-only, external install
Acceptance: Enforce explicit central role; denied requests produce no external action; verify package trust.

Scenario: Changed signer/store, same package version, unsigned JAR/APK
Acceptance: Quarantine before loading; require verified provenance and admin approval; reject unsupported signer.

Scenario: Pending-delete drain, unavailable source, failed delete or restart
Acceptance: Retain durable intent until verified; cache reflects actual files; no automatic physical deletion.
